CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Speed of the 4D rotation; negative values reverse it
CONTROLS.NAME: speed

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How much the bass level pumps the field of view (zoom); negative values pump the opposite way
CONTROLS.NAME: screen_bounce

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How fast colors cycle with distance from the center; higher values give more color bands
CONTROLS.NAME: color_tune

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Radius of the glowing beat rings; 0 puts the glow right on the surfaces
CONTROLS.NAME: glow_width

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Trails: how long bright areas of the previous frame linger
CONTROLS.NAME: after_glow

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Feeds the previous frame back over the new one, building up bloom; at max the image saturates
CONTROLS.NAME: over_glow

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Palette phase of the red (X) and green (Y) channels; shifts the overall hue
CONTROLS.NAME: color_chroma

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Shifts the blue channel's palette phase on bass hits, so colors flash on the beat
CONTROLS.NAME: color_chroma_onbeat

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Camera position along the 4th dimension; changes which slice of the fractal you see
CONTROLS.NAME: woff

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: 4th-dimension camera position on bass hits; the fractal morphs when it differs from the base value
CONTROLS.NAME: woff_onbeat

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Lower beat threshold: audio hits below this level are ignored (keep below the upper threshold)
CONTROLS.NAME: low_level

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Upper beat threshold: audio hits at or above this level count as full strength (keep above the lower threshold)
CONTROLS.NAME: high_level

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Overall opacity of the media layer
CONTROLS.NAME: media_opacity

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Brightness-driven media opacity: 0 makes dark media pixels transparent, 1 ignores brightness
CONTROLS.NAME: lum_opacity

DESCRIPTION: Fly through a pulsing 4D apollonian fractal of glowing bubbles and crystalline spheres, drenched in violet, magenta and icy cyan. Bass hits make the geometry thump and morph, beat-driven rings of light slice through the haze, and trails of glow linger behind every flash. Layer your own media on top and let the fractal breathe around it.
TITLE: ya4a
